sandbox.title: Boli cikanw bɛ dabila
sandbox.body: Novera bɛ a to ciden ka shell cikanw kɛ dɔrɔn ni i ka sistɛm bɛ se k’u datugu. Sandbox si tɛ sɔrɔ yan, o la ciden bɛ se ka dosiyew kalan, k’u sɛbɛn ani k’u ladilan a ka sandbox kɔnɔ — nka a tɛ foyi boli.
sandbox.fixLinux: Linux bɛ baara kɛ ni bubblewrap ye. A sigi sen kan, o kɔ, Novera daminɛ kokura.
sandbox.fixMac: macOS bɛ baara kɛ ni cɛncɛn ye min bɛ a kɔnɔ /usr/bin/sandbox-exec. Novera daminɛ kokura ni a sɔrɔla.
sandbox.fixWindows: Windows bɛ baara kɛ ni AppContainer ye. Novera daminɛ kokura walasa ka segin a kan.
sandbox.recheck: Aw bɛ segin ka a lajɛ

planMode.label: Labɛn
planMode.tooltipOff: Labɛn fɔlɔ — ciden bɛ kalan kɛ ka hakilina di, k’a sɔrɔ a ma sɛbɛn.
planMode.tooltipOn: Labɛnni. O dabila walasa ka ciden bila ka dosiyew sɛbɛn.
planMode.placeholder: Aw ye fɛɛrɛ ɲini. Agent tɛna dosiye si Changé.

budget.stoppedSteps: A jɔra {{max}} senfɛ. Agent ma ban.
budget.keepGoing: Aw ka to ka taa ɲɛ
budget.stoppedTokens: A jɔra — nin kalan in y’a ka token budget gosi.

run.tryAgain: Aw bɛ segin ka a lajɛ

modelNoTools: {{model}} tɛ se ka baarakɛminɛnw wele, o la a tɛ se ka kɛ ciden ye. Baarakɛminɛnw welecogo misali dɔ sugandi.

composer.printPdf: Sɛbɛn / A mara i n'a fɔ PDF .
composer.exportHint: Kalansenw cogoya: bolofara min bɛ baara la. JSON: cikanw bɛɛ lajɛlen. Kɛnɛma dosiyew tɛ fara ɲɔgɔn kan.

telemetry.summary: Ni i sɔnna, {{host}} bɛ Novera bɔko ni baarakɛminɛnw dɔrɔn de sɔrɔ, k’a sɔrɔ barow ma kɛ walima ni taamasiyɛn basigilen tɛ.
telemetry.unavailable: Jateminɛw ma labɛn. Donan si tɛ ci.

errorTracking.title: Misaliw nɔfɛtaama
errorTracking.summary: Laseli minnu bɛ kɛ ni ŋaniya ye {{host}} ma : fili suguya, kode jɔyɔrɔ, a bɔcogo ani baarakɛcogo. Baro, fili cikan raw walima kilisi si tɛ yen. Aw bɛ a bali waati o waati.
errorTracking.unavailable: Misaliw nɔfɛta ma labɛn. Rapport si tɛ ci.

access.ask: Aw ye ɲininkali kɛ sani aw ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ walima ka bɔ yen
access.allow: A to ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli ni bɔli kɛ
access.folderNote: Novera bɛ se ka don nin foli in na cogo min na, o sugandi.

components.title: Sigida yɔrɔw
components.note: Aw mago bɛ fɛn minnu na, olu dɔrɔn de don. Novera bɛ Python sigidaw to ɲɔgɔn na. Sankaba baarakɛlaw mago tɛ sigida sigili la.
components.estimates: Téléchargement estimé: {{download}} · Disiki yɔrɔ wajibiyalen: {{space}} · Disiki yɔrɔ min bɛ sɔrɔ: {{free}}
components.confirm: Nin sigida kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen in sigi sen kan wa? Yɔrɔ sugandilenw dɔrɔn de bɛna telesarse. U ka weleweledalaw ka lase bɛ sirataama.
components.removeConfirm: Aw bɛ nin sigida ɲɛnabɔlen in bɔ yen wa? Aw ka misaliw, aw ka daɲɛw ani aw ka barow bɛna mara.
components.uninstall: Aw bɛ a bɔ a la
components.external: Kɛnɛma Python sira min bɛ se ka sugandi, o bɛ profil ɲɛnabɔlen wuli. A jɛya walasa ka baara kɛ ni Novera ka sigida ye.
components.failed: Kɔnɔnafili baara ma ɲɛ. Aw ye réseau, disiki yɔrɔ ani doncogo hakɛw lajɛ, o kɔ aw bɛ segin k’a lajɛ walima k’a dilan.
components.required: Sigida yɔrɔ wajibiyalenw labɛn ani k’u sɛgɛsɛgɛ Novera · Labɛnw kɔnɔ.
components.rollback: Aw bɛ sigida kɔrɔ lasegin a cogo kɔrɔ la
components.busy: Sigida modɛliw jigin ani ka mɔgɔw makɔnɔ u ka ban ka sɔrɔ ka yɔrɔw Changer.
